title: meta.json: build metadata
description: When and from which collection run the data was exported, the detector settings the numbers were computed with, and the other files of this export.

generated_at.description: The `now` every freshness window and typical low was computed at.

fixture.description: true only in contract/site/v1/fixtures: test data, never deploy a site built from it.

run.description: The latest completed collection run (low prices come from it); null before the first one.

analytics_token.description: Added in v1 (D34): Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon token; null or absent: no beacon script (the zone's automatic setup measures at the edge). Always null in fixtures.

search_widget.description: Added in v1 (D34): src of the Aviasales search form script from Travelpayouts' widget constructor (config.SEARCH_WIDGET_HOSTS); null or absent: no widget. Always null in fixtures.

instagram_handle.description: Added in v1 (D34): the brand's Instagram handle (config brand.handle), the contact on the About and Privacy pages.

detector.description: Settings behind typical lows, low prices and promotions (DECISIONS D3, D24).

min_dates_per_day.description: Added in v1 (D40): a day's low counts towards min_baseline_days only when that day saw at least this many different departure dates. Absent: every day counts (1).

pontes.description: Added in v1 (D31); absent in older exports.

affiliates.description: Added in v1 (D37); absent in older exports.

low_prices.description: Origin airport -> its low-price file (one per origin, loaded lazily by the explorer).
